comment: POSTGAME.md P4c, the amended account, Quy and Hollowell. Prophecy Hall's lectern: absent before the ending; after it, every line of the finale's own tally (read out of Map 12's data) is in it; walked up to and read; bare, it has no THE END and none of the switched lines; ROL-5 told at the door reads as the finale does, told after the ending reads 'over a pie', and Roland back, the signed book, the tea and Quy's afternoon each add their line, in order. Quy: met first after the ending, the afternoon from his own question, with the cup; SW_MET_QUY set by it; his after-page and the pot next door; met before, the afternoon without the cup. Hollowell: never visited, the tour to the book then the notice, no slip; visited and signed, the notice and the entry; the visitors' book with Grimspite in it.

steps.eval: window._lines = []; const add = Game_Message.prototype.add; Game_Message.prototype.add = function (t) { window._lines.push(t); return add.call(this, t); }; window._mark = () => { window._lines = []; window._tropes = $gameVariables.value(2); }; window._mark(); window._has = s => window._lines.some(l => l.includes(s));

steps.label: before the ending: no lectern, and its square is open
after it: the lectern, by the door

steps.eval: const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('GET', 'data/Map012.json', false); x.send(); const L = JSON.parse(x.responseText).events[2].pages[0].list.filter(c => c.code === 401).map(c => c.parameters[0]); const a = L.findIndex(t => t.includes('THE OBLIGATORY QUEST')); const b = L.findIndex(t => t.includes('It took most of an afternoon.')); window._finale = L.slice(a + 1, b + 1); window._lectern = $gameMap.event(15).event().pages[1].list.filter(c => c.code === 401).map(c => c.parameters[0]);

steps.label: every line of the finale's tally is in the amended account
walked up to it from the carpet and read it

steps.check: [window._has("A lectern by the door"), window._has("THE OBLIGATORY QUEST, as amended"), window._has("Thistlewick struck clause twelve"), window._has("The account ends there"), window._has("He came back with all of them."), window._has("THE END"), window._has("she waited at the door"), window._has("most of an afternoon"), window._has("quarterly report"), window._has("It was just tea.")]

reading it counts nothing

steps.check: ["Sir Dunstable lent the lamp", "warden of the half-way landing", "chapel porch at least"].map(s => window._has(s))
steps.label: the bare account says nothing of the Stair

steps.check: [window._has("who thinks about this one"), window._has("she waited at the door"), window._has("over a pie"), window._has("engaged again")]
steps.label: ROL-5 told before the ending: the finale's own line

steps.check: [window._has("she waited at the door"), window._has("over a pie"), window._has("the bit after"), window._has("engaged again"), window._has("quarterly report"), window._has("It was just tea."), window._has("most of an afternoon"), window._has("The account ends there")]

steps.eval: window._order = ['quarterly report', 'It was just tea.', 'Thistlewick struck clause twelve', 'most of an afternoon', 'The account ends there'].map(s => window._lines.findIndex(l => l.includes(s)))

steps.check: window._order.every((v, i, a) => i === 0 || a[i - 1] < v)

steps.check: (() => { const f = s => window._lines.findIndex(l => l.includes(s)); const s = ["Sir Dunstable lent the lamp", "warden of the half-way landing", "chapel porch at least"].map(f); return [s.every(i => i >= 0), f('It was just tea.') < s[0], s[0] < s[1] && s[1] < s[2], s[2] < f('Thistlewick struck clause twelve')]; })()
